site_name: Wembley National Stadium, Olympic Way, Wembley, HA9 0WS
description: Details pursuant to condition 4 (south east ramp and gate 3) of Full Planning Permission reference 22/4289 dated 21 July, 2023, for Works to Wembley National Stadium to include installation of fencing and roller shutters (B1 and B2 Steps), external alterations to existing Club Wembley, staff, media and VIP entrances and staff fire exit, with perimeter fencing introduced adjacent staff and media entrances (all at Level B2), and installation of roller shutters within existing gantries (north-west and north-east ramps), development of a high-level 'Gate 3' fence (south-west concourse) and gated-fencing (east steps and south east ramp) (all at Level 1)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
